roleContext.jobDescription: A software company selling project-management tools to construction firms runs a 40-person sales and customer-success organisation. The Revenue Operations Manager keeps the CRM and the quote-to-cash process in order, runs the weekly forecast roll-up, builds the pipeline reporting used by leadership and rolls out new workflow automation in the CRM. The hiring manager wants the evidence packets in hand before choosing who goes through to the final interview. The role reports to the chief revenue officer and works with the finance team on billing and with the sales leaders on territory and quota changes. The company runs Salesforce Sales Cloud and CPQ, with Tableau for reporting.

requirements.text: Administers the CRM, including fields, validation rules and user permissions.
Runs the weekly sales forecast roll-up with the regional sales leads.
Builds pipeline and conversion reporting for the leadership team.
Designs and rolls out new workflow automation in the CRM (for example Salesforce Flow).
Maintains the quote-to-cash process between the CRM and the billing system.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Revenue Operations Manager

## Experience

- Administered Salesforce for a 60-user sales team at Brackenfield Software: page layouts, validation rules, profiles and permission sets, with a monthly access review.
- Ran the Monday forecast call with four regional sales leads, rolling up commit and best-case figures into the forecast sent to the CFO by noon.
- Built the pipeline and stage-conversion dashboards in Salesforce and Tableau that the leadership team uses in its weekly meeting.
- Maintained the quote-to-cash link between Salesforce CPQ and the Chargebee billing system, reconciling closed-won deals against invoices at each month end.
- Migrated three legacy workflow rules to Process Builder in 2019 with the help of an external consultant.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the month-end reconciliation workbook for one month, matching 214 closed-won opportunities to billing invoices, with the 6 mismatches listed and the correction made for each.
